full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiffs, in short, is that 0.09 acres of land appertains to CS and SA plot Nos. 9, 10, 12 12/87 of CS khatian Nos. 38 and 39 originally belonged to Sebesawor Das who settled the said land in favour of Sashi Kanto Dutta by a registered patta deed on 23rd Falgun, 1310 BS Sashi Kanta Dutta also settled the land in favour of Krishna Mohan Das and others by a registered patta on 11th jaista 1312 BS Krishna Mohan Das transferred the land by a registered kabala in favour of Gobinda Chandra Roy Chowdhury on 11th Vhadra, 1312 BS. The heirs of Gobinda Chandra Roy Chowdhury transferred the land by a kabala on 12th Boishakh, 1323 BS in favour of Bhabu Mohendra Chandra Dhar.
